comments.content: ClearDataTask now inherits gin_helper::CleanedUpAtExit but is still allocated with `new` and manually `delete this` in OnTaskFinished. CleanedUpAtExit registers the object for deletion at node shutdown, so manual delete this will lead to a double delete / use-after-free. Either remove the manual self-delete and rely on CleanedUpAtExit, or do not inherit CleanedUpAtExit and keep the original self-owning lifetime.

Deleting `this` in OnTaskFinished after resolving/rejecting the promise means the ClearDataTask object is destroyed while CleanedUpAtExit still holds a pointer to it for later cleanup. This is the double-free path mentioned above and also makes the raw_ptr<ClearDataTask> held by in-flight ClearDataOperation dangling if the task is destroyed via CleanedUpAtExit before all operations finish.
